name: Difficult Times
overview: Scripture reveals that difficult times are inevitable in the believer's journey, yet God commands us to be strong and courageous, assuring His presence wherever we go (Joshua 1:9). He is our refuge and strength in trouble (Psalms 9:9), offering peace and help through His righteous hand (Isaiah 41:10). Though we face tribulation in the world, Jesus encourages us to be of good cheer because He has overcome the world (John 16:33), and God’s plans for us are of peace and hope, not harm (Jeremiah 29:11). Believers are called to trust God rather than fret over the actions of evildoers (Psalms 37:1), resting in His sovereign care during trials.
